records.title: Elementary Turkish
records.text: TKISH 102 Elementary Turkish (5) A&H Develops proficiency in modern Turkish through a task-based, communicative, and culturally grounded approach. Students expand their language skills through increasingly complex real-world tasks and authentic materials while deepening their understanding of Turkish-speaking communities, cultural practices, and contemporary life. Integrates language, culture, and community engagement. Second in a sequence of three. Maximum 15 credits allowed between TKISH 101; TKISH 102; TKISH 103; and TKISH 105. Prerequisite: TKISH 101. Offered: W.

records.title: Elementary Turkish
records.text: TKISH 103 Elementary Turkish (5) A&H Students develop greater proficiency in speaking, listening, reading, and writing through a communicative, task-based approach. Expands grammar and vocabulary while exploring Turkish culture, arts, history, and society through authentic materials. Students strengthen fluency, intercultural awareness, and real-world communication skills. Third in a sequence of three. Maximum 15 credits allowed between TKISH 101; TKISH 102; TKISH 103; and TKISH 105. Prerequisite: TKISH 102. Offered: Sp.

records.title: Early Decades of the Republic's Turkish Language Reforms
records.header: TKISH 406 Early Decades of the Republic's Turkish Language Reforms (5) A&H
records.text: TKISH 406 Early Decades of the Republic's Turkish Language Reforms (5) A&H Turkish language and alphabet reforms studied with selections from journalistic, scientific, and literary writings from 1920-1950. Introduces older forms of the language and provides a basic knowledge of the early decades of the Turkish republic. Involves practices on speaking, reading, writing, and presentation skills in the modern Turkish language. Prerequisite: TKISH 203.
